name: SS Vascular Graft Surveillance and Transplant Workup

reference.source: SVS/ESVS bypass surveillance and vascular graft infection guidance, ISHLT listing, procurement and rejection guidance, Indian THOTA and NOTTO transplant rules (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Duplex-patrolled vein grafts rescued before occlusion
Infected prosthesis excised with clean-plane rerouting
Pulsatile scars mean pseudoaneurysm for repair
reference.pathophysiology: Transplant candidates earn cardiac, infection, cancer and sensitisation screens with iliac maps, voluntary consent and fair registry listing while brain-death exams with apnea testing certify donors for cold-perfused retrieval. Vein bypass grafts earn duplex patrols rescuing stenoses by angioplasty, infected prostheses earn excision with clean-plane rerouting, pulsatile scars earn pseudoaneurysm repair, and lifelong follow balances rejection against infection with PTLD watches.
